name: shipx
description: Interactive release CLI — bump, tag, publish, and ship your packages with a beautiful terminal UI

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node && node -e "const f=require('fs');const c=f.readFileSync('dist/cli.js','utf8');f.writeFileSync('dist/cli.js',c.replace('#!/usr/bin/env bun','#!/usr/bin/env node').replace('// @bun\n',''))"

author: Lacy Morrow <lacy@lacymorrow.com>
